item.title: AutoHide, Mail, Tabs — Vivaldi Browser snapshot 3989.3
item.description: In this snapshot, we have AutoHide, Mail and Crash fixes, a big rewrite to how Tabs work underneath the hood and security updates from us and Chromium.

item.title: Vivaldi 7.9 for Mobile: Two levels of tabs, beautiful images, Safari import and Desktop Mode | Vivaldi Browser
item.description: Vivaldi 7.9 for Mobile is a big one. iOS users finally get a signature Vivaldi feature Android fans have enjoyed for years, Two-Level Tab Stacks! Both Android and iOS get the daily image feature…
